    /**
     * Unterdrückt Astras automatisch generierte „Ähnliche Beiträge“ auf
     * Einzelbeiträgen fail-closed. Dadurch erscheint unter dem kontrollierten
     * Artikelabschluss kein zusätzlicher Bild-/Beitragsblock.
     */
    public static function disable_astra_related_posts_query_v150329($args) {
        if (!is_singular('post')) {
            return $args;
        }
        $args = is_array($args) ? $args : [];
        $args['post__in'] = [0];
        $args['ignore_sticky_posts'] = true;
        return $args;
    }

    private static function intro_accordion_top_level_taboo_v150395() {

    private static function page_shortline_html($page_id, $type = '') {

        $text = trim((string)get_post_meta($page_id, self::META_PAGE_SHORTLINE, true));
        if ($text === '') { return ''; }

        return '<div class="pftk-page-shortline" data-pftk-page-shortlin

    private static function page_shortline_html($page_id, $type = '') {
        $page_id = absint($page_id);
        if ($page_id <= 0 || !empty(self::$page_shortline_rendered[$page_id])) { return ''; }
        $type = $type !== '' ? sanitize_key($type) : self::page_type_for_id($page_id);
        if (!in_array($type, ['start','hub1','hub2','category'], true)) { return ''; }
        if (get_post_meta($page_id, self::META_PAGE_SHORTLINE_HIDDEN, true) === '1') { return ''; }
        $text = trim((string)get_post_meta($page_id, self::META_PAGE_SHORTLINE, true));
        if ($text === '') { return ''; }
        self::$page_shortline_rendered[$page_id] = true;
        return '<div class="pftk-page-shortline" data-pftk-page-shortline="1"><p>' . esc_html($text) . '</p></div>';
    }

    public static function prepend_page_shortline_to_content($content) {
        if (is_admin() || is_feed() || !is_singular('page') || !in_the_loop() || !is_main_query()) { return $content; }
        if (strpos((string)$content, 'data-pftk-page-shortline="1"') !== false) { return $content; }
        $page_id = absint(get_the_ID());
        $html = self::page_shortline_html($page_id);
        return $html !== '' ? $html . $content : $content;
    }

    public static function handle_save_category_text_settings() {
        if (!current_user_can('manage_options')) { wp_die('Keine Berechtigung.'); }
        check_admin_referer('pftk_save_category_text_settings', 'pftk_category_text_nonce');
        $raw = isset($_POST['pftk_category_text']) && is_array($_POST['pftk_category_text']) ? wp_unslash($_POST['pftk_category_text']) : [];
        update_option(self::OPTION_CATEGORY_TEXT_SETTINGS, self::sanitize_category_text_settings($raw), false);
        wp_safe_redirect(add_query_arg(['page' => 'pferde-template-kit-kategorietexte', 'saved' => '1'], admin_url('admin.php')));
        exit;
    }

    public static function settings_page($type) {
        if (!current_user_can('manage_options')) { return; }
        $templates = self::templates();
        if (empty($templates[$type])) { return; }
        $cfg = $templates[$type];
        $group = $cfg['prefix'] . '_settings';

        echo '<div class="wrap pftk-admin pftk-admin-v150312">';
        echo '<h1>Pferde Template Kit – ' . esc_html($cfg['label']) . '</h1>';
        echo '<p><strong>Shortcode:</strong> <code>' . esc_html($cfg['shortcode']) . '</code></p>';
        echo '<p>';
        foreach ($templates as $t => $c) {
            $url = admin_url('admin.php?page=' . $c['slug']);
            $style = $t === $type ? 'font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;' : '';
            echo '<a style="margin-right:16px;' . esc_attr($style) . '" href="' . esc_url($url) . '">' . esc_html($c['label']) . '</a>';
        }
        echo '</p>';
        self::settings_backend_contract_summary_v150312($type);
        echo '<form method="post" action="options.php">';
        settings_fields($group)

===== HIT =====

_automatic($type);
            self::settings_hub_grid_status($type);
        }

        submit_button('Inhalte speichern');
        echo '</form></div>';
    }

    private static function settings_backend_contract_summary_v150312($type) {
        $labels = [
            'start' => 'Startseite',
            'hub1' => 'Hub Ebene 1',
            'hub2' => 'Hub Ebene 2',
            'category' => 'Produkt-/Kategorieebene',
        ];
        echo '<div class="notice notice-info inline"><p><strong>Backend verschlankt:</strong> Farben, Schriften, Abstände, Raster, Kartenhöhen, Hoverzustände, Breadcrumb-Stil und responsive Regeln sind durch Plugin und Designverträge festgelegt. Diese Werte werden hier nicht mehr doppelt angeboten.</p></div>';
        echo '<div style="margin:16px 0;padding:16px 18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c3c4c7;border-radius:8px;max-width:980px">';
        echo '<h2 style="margin-top:0">Verbindlicher Bereich: ' . esc_html($labels[$type] ?? $type) . '</h2>';
        echo '<ul style="list-style:disc;padding-left:22px">';
        echo '<li><strong>Änderbar:</strong> redaktionelle Inhalte, Zielseiten, Bilder, Zuordnungen und ausdrücklich freigegebene Sichtbarkeiten.</li>';
        echo '<li><strong>Gesperrt:</strong> Designwerte, Navigationstiefe, Karten- und Buttondesign, Farben, Typografie, Abstände und responsive Logik.</li>';
        echo '<li><strong>Affiliate-Inhalte:</strong> ausschließlich in der Affiliate-Zentrale; keine parallelen Banner- oder Produktfelder im Designbackend.</li>';
        echo '</ul>';
        echo '<p class="description">Historische Optionen bleiben intern gespeichert, damit bestehende Installationen nicht beschädigt werden. Sie sind kein aktiver Designvertrag und werden nicht mehr als reguläre Eingabefelder angezeigt.</p>';
        echo '</div>';
    }

    private static function render_shortcode_template($requested_type, $atts = []) {
        $allowed = ['start', 'hub1', 'hub2', 'category', 'leaf'];
        $requested_type = in_array($requested_type, $allowed, true) ? $requested_type : 'category';
        $resolved_type = $requested_type;

        // Auf echten Seiten entscheidet immer die reale Seitenstruktur. Alte oder
        // falsch hinterlegte Shortcodes duerfen keinen zweiten/falschen Seitentyp ausgeben.
        $blocked_wrong_shortcode = false;
        if (!is_admin() && is_singular('page')) {
            if (function_exists('is_front_page') && is_front_page()) {
                $resolved_type = 'start';
            } else {
                $current = self::current_page_as_menu_like_item();
                $actual = self::current_page_template_type($current);
                if (in_array($actual, $allowed, true)) {
                    $resolved_type = $actual;
                } elseif (in_array($requested_type, ['start','hub1','hub2'], true)) {
                    // Ein alter Start-/Hub-Shortcode darf auf einer nicht eindeutig
                    // erkannten Unterseite niemals den Startseiten- oder Hubaufbau zeigen.
                    $blocked_wrong_shortcode = true;
                }
            }
        }

        $debug = current_user_can('manage_options')
            ? '<!-- pftk-v' . esc_html(self::VERSION) . ' template_shortcode requested=' . esc_html($requested_type) . ' resolved=' . esc_html($resolved_type) . ' -->'
            : '';

        if ($blocked_wrong_shortcode) {
            return $debug . (current_user_can('manage_options') ? '<!-- pftk-v' . esc_html(self::VERSION) . ' template_shortcode blocked=wrong_page_type -->' : '');
        }

        // Ein Volltemplate darf pro Seitenaufruf nur einmal erscheinen.
        if (!empty(self::$r

===== HIT =====


        if ($blocked_wrong_shortcode) {
            return $debug . (current_user_can('manage_options') ? '<!-- pftk-v' . esc_html(self::VERSION) . ' template_shortcode blocked=wrong_page_type -->' : '');
        }

        // Ein Volltemplate darf pro Seitenaufruf nur einmal erscheinen.
        if (!empty(self::$rendered_types[$resolved_type])) {
            return $debug . (current_user_can('manage_options')
                ? '<!-- pftk-v' . esc_html(self::VERSION) . ' template_shortcode duplicate=blocked type=' . esc_html($resolved_type) . ' -->'
                : '');
        }

        // Der Kategorietext wird ab V1.50.13 direkt im einheitlichen
        // Portalcontainer gerendert. Dadurch ist seine Position auf allen
        // Ebenen und bei allen Ausgabewegen identisch.
        return $debug . self::render($resolved_type, $atts);
    }

    /** Normalisiert ausschließlich den aktuellen Request-Pfad ohne Query. */
    private static function current_request_path_v150387() {
        $uri = isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']) ? (string)$_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] : '';
        if ($uri === '') { return ''; }
        if (function_exists('wp_parse_url')) {
            $path = wp_parse_url($uri, PHP_URL_PATH);
        } else {
            $path = parse_url($uri, PHP_URL_PATH);
        }
        if (!is_string($path)) { return ''; }
        return trim($path, '/');
    }

    /**
     * V1.50.465 / Contract V100 – registrierte Journal-Kategoriearchive.
     *
     * Ursache V94–V99: Die Archive wurden wiederholt gegen vermutetes Astra-Markup
     * nachgestylt. Das reale Theme-Markup und die aktive Astra-Konfiguration konnten
     * dadurch einzelne native Meta-/Content-Elemente weiter sichtbar lassen.
     *
     * V100 besitzt deshalb die sichtbare Karte in diesem eng begrenzten Scope selbst:
     * astra_entry_top rendert dieselben sichtbaren Klassen und dieselbe Struktur wie
     * journal_post_cards_v150280(). Das danach von Astra erzeugte native Innenmarkup
     * bleibt technisch im DOM, wird aber ausschließlich in diesen registrierten
     * Journal-Karten ausgeblendet. Andere Archive bleiben vollständig unberührt.
     */
    public static function journal_category_post_class_v150465($classes, $class = '', $post_id = 0) {
        if (!is_array($classes)) { $classes = []; }
        if (is_admin() || !is_category() || !is_main_query() || (function_exists('in_the_loop') && !in_the_loop())) { return $classes; }
        $term = get_queried_object();

    }

     */
    private static function hub1_category_key_v150210($page_id = 0) {
        $page_id = absint($page_id);
        if ($page_id <= 0 && is_singular('page')) { $page_id = absint(get_queried_object_id()); }
        $post = $page_id > 0 ? get_post($page_id) : null;
        $title = $post instanceof WP_Post ? get_the_title($post) : '';
        $slug = $post instanceof WP_Post ? (string)$post->post_name : '';
        $haystack = self::normalize_match_key($title . ' ' . $slug);
        $rules = [
            'ausruestung' => ['ausruestung','ausstattung','equipment'],
            'stall' => ['stall','stallhaltung'],
            'weide' => ['weide','koppel'],
            'fuetterung' => ['fuetterung','futter','ernaehrung'],
            'gesundheit' => ['gesundheit','pferdegesundheit'],
            'training' => ['training','ausbildung','reitweisen'],
            'transport' => ['transport','unterwegs','anhaenger'],
            'wissen' => ['wissen','ratgeber','magazin'],
        ];
        foreach ($rules as $key => $tokens) {
            foreach ($tokens as $token) {
                if ($haystack === $token || strpos($haystack, $token) !== false) { return $key; }
            }
        }
        return 'generic';
    }

    private static function hub1_product_content_is_real_v150214($candidate) {
        $candidate = trim((string)$candidate);
        if ($candidate === '') { return false; }
        $plain = strtolower(trim(wp_strip_all_tags($candidate)));
        $markers = ['affiliate-werbefläche', 'affiliate werbefläche', 'produktplatz', 'noch nicht belegt', 'nicht belegt', 'placeholder', 'platzhalter'];
        foreach ($markers as $marker) {
            if ($plain !== '' && strpos($plain, $marker) !== false) { return false; }
            if (strpos(strtolower($candidate), $marker) !== false) { return false; }
        }
        $has_link = stripos($candidate, '<a') !== false && stripos($candidate, 'href=') !== false;
        $has_content = stripos($candidate, '<img') !== false || mb_strlen($plain) >= 12;
        return $has_link && $has_content;
    }

    private static function hub1_products_v150356($page_title = '', $test_state = '') {
        $slots = [];
        $product_count = 0;
        if ($test_state === 'both' || $test_state === 'products') {
            for ($i = 1; $i <= 3; $i++) {
                $slots[] = self::hub1_test_product_v150356($i, $page_title);
                $product_count++;
            }
        } elseif ($test_state !== 'banner' && $test_state !== 'none') {
            for ($i = 1; $i <= 3; $i++) {
                $slot = self::hub1_product_slot_v150210($i);
                if (!empty($slot['html'])) { $slots[] = $slot['html']; }
                if (!empty($slot['is_product'])) { $product_count++; }
            }
        }
        if ($product_count <= 0) { return ['html'=>'','count'=>0]; }
        $out = '<section class="pa356-products" data-pftk-product-count="' . intval($product_count) . '"><header><span>Produktvorschläge</span><h2>Passend zu ' . esc_html($page_title) . ' ausgewählt</h2><p>Nur Produkte mit nachvollziehbarem Bezug zum jeweiligen Themenbereich.</p></header><div class="pa356-product-grid">' . implode('', $slots) . '</div></section>';
        return ['html'=>$out,'count'=>$product_count];
    }

        }

        $heading_tag = $type === 'start' ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        return '<section class="pftk-hero pftk-curve ' . ($visual ? 'has-visual' : 'no-visual') . '">' .

            if ($found && trim((string)$found['url']) !== '') { $items[] = $found; }
        }
        if (!$items) { return ''; }
        $out = '<section class="pftk-home-section-v150170" id="pftk-start-themen"><header class="pftk-home-heading-v150170"><span>Pferdethemen</span><h2>Was dein Pferd bewegt</h2></header><div class="pftk-home-categories-v150170">';

    private static function render_guide($type) {
        $title = self::text($type, 'guide_title');
        $intro = self::text($type, 'guide_intro');
        $cards = [
            ['01', self::text($type, 'guide_1_title'), self::text($type, 'guide_1_text'), '#pftk-topics'],
            ['02', self::text($type, 'guide_2_title'), self::text($type, 'guide_2_text'), '#pftk-posts'],
            ['03', self::text($type, 'guide_3_title'), self::text($type, 'guide_3_text'), '#pftk-structure'],
        ];
        $has = false;
        foreach ($cards as $c) { if ($c[1] !== '' || $c[2] !== '') { $has = true; } }
        if ($title === '' && $intro === '' && !$has) { return ''; }

        $out = '<section class="pftk-section" id="pftk-guide"><div class="pftk-section-head">' .
            ($title !== '' ? '<h2 class="pftk-heading pftk-heading-guide_title">' . esc_html($title) . '</h2>' : '') .
            ($intro !== '' ? '<p>' . esc_html($intro) . '</p>' : '') .
            '</div><div class="pftk-guide-grid">';
        foreach ($cards as $i => $c) {
            if ($c[1] === '' && $c[2] === '') { continue; }
            $out .= '<a class="pftk-card pftk-card-guide pftk-curve" style="--pftk-accent:' . esc_attr(self::color($i)) . '" href="' . esc_url($c[3]) . '">' .
                '<span class="pftk-number">' . esc_html($c[0]) . '</span>' .
                ($c[1] !== '' ? '<strong class="pftk-heading pftk-heading-card_title">' . esc_html($c[1]) . '</strong>' : '') .
                ($c[2] !== '' ? '<em>' . esc_html($c[2]) . '</em>' : '') .
                '</a>';
        }
        return $out . '</div></section>';
    }

    private static function top_posts_for_product_context($cat_ids, $limit, $current = null) {
        $limit = max(1, min(50, intval($limit)));
        $picked = [];
        $seen = [];

        if (!empty($cat_ids)) {
            foreach (self::top_posts_by_importance($cat_ids, $limit) as $post) {
                if ($post instanceof WP_Post && empty($seen[$post->ID])) { $picked[] = $post; $seen[$post->ID] = true; }
                if (count($picked) >= $limit) { return $picked; }
            }
        }

        // Fallback fuer Seiten, bei denen Kategorien zwar semantisch existieren,
        // aber nicht sauber als cat_ids durchgereicht werden: suche publizierte
        // Beitr

===== HIT =====

ize_match_key($needle)) { return $label; }
        }
        if (strpos($norm, 'decken') !== false || strpos($norm, 'decke') !== false) { return $topic . ' für Pferde'; }
        if (strpos($norm, 'futter') !== false) { return 'Pferde' . lcfirst($topic); }
        return $topic . ' für Pferde';
    }


    private static function render_media_block($type) {
        $feature = self::media($type, 'feature_image');
        $banner1 = self::media($type, 'banner_1_image');
        $banner2 = self::media($type, 'banner_2_image');
        $banner1_text = self::text($type, 'banner_1_text');
        $banner2_text = self::text($type, 'banner_2_text');
        if ($feature === '' && $banner1 === '' && $banner2 === '' && $banner1_text === '' && $banner2_text === '') { return ''; }

        $title = self::text($type, 'media_title');
        $intro = self::text($type, 'media_intro');
        $out = '<section class="pftk-section"><div class="pftk-section-head">' .
            ($title !== '' ? '<h2 class="pftk-heading pftk-heading-media_title">' . esc_html($title) . '</h2>' : '') .
            ($intro !== '' ? '<p>' . esc_html($intro) . '</p>' : '') .
            '</div><div class="pftk-media-grid">';

        if ($feature !== '') {
            $alt = self::media($type, 'feature_alt') ?: $title;
            $inner = '<img src="' . esc_url($feature) . '" alt="' . esc_attr($alt) . '">';
            $out .= '<div class="pftk-photo-box pftk-curve">' . self::wrap_link($inner, self::media($type, 'feature_url'), self::media($type, 'feature_target'), false, 'pftk-image-link') . '</div>';
        }
        $out .= self::banner_box($type, 1);
        $out .= self::banner_box($type, 2);
        return $out . '</div></section>';
    }

        $title = self::text($type, 'media_title');
        $intro = self::text($type, 'media_intro');
        $out = '<section class="pftk-section"><div class="pftk-section-head">' .
            ($title !== '' ? '<h2 class="pftk-heading pftk-heading-media_title">' . esc_html($title) . '</h2>' : '') .
            ($intro !== '' ? '<p>' . esc_html($intro) . '</p>' : '') .
            '</div><div class="pftk-media-grid">';

        if ($feature !== '') {
            $alt = self::media($type, 'feature_alt') ?: $title;
            $inner = '<img src="' . esc_url($feature) . '" alt="' . esc_attr($alt) . '">';
            $out .= '<div class="pftk-photo-box pftk-curve">' . self::wrap_link($inner, self::media($type, 'feature_url'), self::media($type, 'feature_target'), false, 'pftk-image-link') . '</div>';
        }
        $out .= self::banner_box($type, 1);
        $out .= self::banner_box($type, 2);
        return $out . '</div></section>';
    }

    private static function hub_grid_affiliate_context($type, $placement_index = 1, $placement_mode = 'grid') {

        $slug = '';
        $url = '';

            $id = intval($object->ID);
            $title = get_the_title($object);

            $url = get_permalink($object);
        } elseif (is_object($object)) {
            $title = isset($object->name) ? (string)$object->name : '';
            $slug = isset($object->slug) ? (string)$object->slug : '';
        }

            'template' => $type,
            'object_id' => $id,
            'title' => trim((string)$title),

            'url' => trim((string)$url),
            'slot' => $type === 'category' ? 'product_after_category_tiles' : 'hub_grid_card',
            'placement_index' => max(1, intval($placement_index)),
            'placement_mode' => sanitize_key((string)$placement_mode) ?: 'grid',
            'allow_placeholder' => $placement_mode !== 'leaf_category',


===== HIT =====

        $sources = [];
        for ($position = 1; $position <= 2; $position++) {
            $data = self::hub_grid_affiliate_data('category', $position, 'leaf_category');

            $source = sanitize_key((string)($data['source'] ?? ''));

            $card = self::hub_grid_ad_card('category', $data, 'pftk-leaf-category-ad');

    }

        }
        if (is_category()) {

        }
        return [];
    }

        $rendered[$context] = true;
        echo '<div class="pftk-universal-breadcrumb-wrap pftk-breadcrumb-' . esc_attr($context) . '">' . $html . '</div>';
    }

    /**
     * V1.50.469 / Contract V104 – non-collapsing post-table gap for generated tables.
     *
     * V103 is explicitly NOT accepted as proof: its local reference compared a
     * legacy table->H2 transition with a generated table->paragraph transition.
     * That was an invalid apples-to-oranges geometry test. Live V103 then showed
     * no visible change, so its semantic adjacency selector cannot be treated as
     * a proven representation of the rendered WordPress DOM.
     *
     * V104 removes that dependency. The final browser DOM is inspected after the
     * article-design runtime has executed. Production-table signatures are the
     * table classes themselves (comparison-table/system-129-table), with the
     * semantic/article/wrapper markers retained as additional evidence. When the
     * actual following content node is a paragraph, a real 28px spacer element is
     * inserted. A real element cannot collapse with paragraph margins, unlike the
     * earlier margin-only fixes. Plain legacy Gutenberg tables stay untouched.
     */
    public static function enforce_generated_table_follow_gap_v150469() {

  function generatedTable(table){
    if(!table||table.tagName!=='TABLE')return false;
    if(table.matches('.system-129-table,.comparison-table'))return true;
    if(table.closest('article.ppm-generated,article[data-article-type]'))return true;
    if(table.closest('section[data-block="table"]'))return true;
    if(table.closest('.pm-table-wrap'))return true;
    if(table.matches('.comparison-table')&&table.querySelector('[data-fact-ids]'))return true;
    return false;
  }

  function outerBlock(table){
    var candidates=['.pm-table-wrap.wp-block-table','.comparison-table-wrap','figure.wp-block-table','.wp-block-table'];
    for(var i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){
      var n=table.closest(candidates[i]);
      if(n&&entry.contains(n))return n;
    }
    return table;
  }

  function nextElementAfter(node){
    var cur=node;
    while(cur&&cur!==entry){
      if(cur.nextElementSibling)return cur.nextElementSibling;
      cur=cur.parentElement;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function directFollowingParagraph(block){
    var next=nextElementAfter(block);
    if(!next)return null;
    if(next.tagName==='P')return next;
    // Nur transparente Einzelelement-Wrapper durchlaufen; niemals in den naechsten
    // semantischen Abschnitt hineinwandern. H2/H3 und Fazit bleiben unangetastet.
    if(next.matches('div:empty'))return null;
    if(next.matches('section,[data-block],h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6'))return null;
    var p=next.querySelector&&next.querySelector(':scope > p:first-child');
    return p||null;
  }

    entry.querySelectorAll('tabl

  function directFollowingParagraph(block){
    var next=nextElementAfter(block);
    if(!next)return null;
    if(next.tagName==='P')return next;
    // Nur transparente Einzelelement-Wrapper durchlaufen; niemals in den naechsten
    // semantischen Abschnitt hineinwandern. H2/H3 und Fazit bleiben unangetastet.
    if(next.matches('div:empty'))return null;

  function apply(){
    entry.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(function(table){
      if(!generatedTable(table))return;
      var block=outerBlock(table);
      var p=directFollowingParagraph(block);
      if(!p)return;
      block.style.setProperty('margin-bottom','0','important');
      var prev=p.previousElementSibling;
      if(prev&&prev.classList.contains('pa-ppm-table-follow-spacer-v150469'))return;
      var spacer=document.createElement('div');
      spacer.className='pa-ppm-table-follow-spacer-v150469';
      spacer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      p.parentNode.insertBefore(spacer,p);
    });
  }

  apply();
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',apply,{once:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',apply,{once:true});
  new MutationObserver(apply).observe(entry,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();

    public static function auto_append_category_tiles_to_content($content) {
        // Keine Admin-, Feed-, Archiv- oder Fremdloop-Ausgabe.
        if (is_admin() || is_feed() || !is_singular('page') || !in_the_loop() || !is_main_query()) { return $content; }

        $current = self::current_page_as_menu_like_item();
        $page_type = self::current_page_template_type($current);
        if (in_array($page_type, ['start', 'hub1', 'hub2', 'category', 'leaf'], true)) {
            $content = self::normalize_portal_spacing_content($content);
        }

        // Hubseiten ohne bereits ausgegebenen Shortcode automatisch mit dem richtigen
        // Hub-Template versorgen. Quelle sind echte direkte, veroeffentlichte Unterseiten;
        // Kategorie-Matching darf Hub 1/2 niemals ersetzen.
        if (in_array($page_type, ['hub1', 'hub2'], true)) {
            // Sobald bereits irgendein Volltemplate gerendert wurde, niemals ein

view_day_timestamp_v150297($day) {
        $day = sanitize_text_field((string)$day);
        $dt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $day, wp_timezone());
        return $dt instanceof DateTimeImmutable ? $dt->getTimestamp() : false;
    }

    private static function post_view_token_v150297($post_id, $day) {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', absint($post_id) . '|' . sanitize_text_field((string)$day), wp_salt('nonce'));
    }

    private static function post_view_is_bot_v150297($user_agent) {
        $ua = strtolower((string)$user_agent);
        if ($ua === '') { return false; }
        return (bool)preg_match('/bot|crawl|spider|slurp|bingpreview|facebookexternalhit|whatsapp|telegrambot|monitor|uptime|headless|lighthouse|pagespeed|preview/i', $ua);
    }

    public static function render_post_view_beacon_v150297() {
        if (is_admin() || is_feed() || is_preview() || !is_singular('post')) { return; }
        $post_id = absint(get_queried_object_id());
        if ($post_id < 1 || current_user_can('edit_post', $post_id)) { return; }
        $post = get_post($post_id);
        if (!$post instanceof WP_Post || $post->post_status !== 'publish') { return; }
        $day = self::post_view_day_v150297();
        $data = [
            'endpoint' => admin_url('admin-ajax.php'),

     * V1.50.36: Reagiert auf die reale Breite jeder einzelnen Navigationskachel.
     * Nur der problematische schmale Zwischenbereich wird vertikal dargestellt.

    public static function responsive_card_layout_script() {
        if (is_admin()) { return; }
        echo <<<'HTML'
<script id="pftk-responsive-card-layout-v15036">
(function(){
  var selector=".pftk .pftk-card.pftk-card-nav.pftk-has-category-icon";
  var limit=285;
  function update(card){
    var width=card.getBoundingClientRect().width||0;
    card.classList.toggle("pftk-card-narrow",width>0&&width<=limit);
  }
  function scan(){document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(function(card){observe(card);update(card);});}
  var seen=new WeakSet();
  var ro=window.ResizeObserver?new ResizeObserver(function(entries){entries.forEach(function(entry){update(entry.target);});}):null;
  function observe(card){if(seen.has(card))return;seen.add(card);if(ro)ro.observe(card);}
  if(document.readyState==="loading")document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",scan);else scan();
  window.addEventListener("resize",scan,{passive:true});
  new MutationObserver(scan).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();
</scr

===== HIT =====

;
    });
    return cache[src];
  }
  function apply(card){
    if(card.getAttribute("data-pftk-autocrop"))return;
    state(card,"pending");
    var img=card.querySelector(".pftk-hub-grid-ad-image>img");
    var src=img?(img.currentSrc||img.src||""):"";
    if(!src){state(card,"no-image");return;}
    createCrop(src).then(function(url){if(url){card.style.setProperty("background-image","url(\""+url+"\")","important");state(card,"done");}else{state(card,"skipped");}});
  }
  function run(){document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(apply);}
  if(document.readyState==="loading")document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",run);else run();
  window.addEventListener("load",run,{once:true});
  new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();
</script>
HTML;
    }
